body:
Fix concrete Apple Silicon compatibility and engine failure paths. Based on main `f3f2c1d5e564cacf1b2bf2675bf972c8fc4f3ea6`; separate from #61. Final head `16c765aade25ad6ff85f974aa6da16e3d93ae4df` is pushed, remote-SHA verified and locally clean. No numerical shader, quantization or experimental-default change.

## Fixes and reproductions

- **M5/macOS 26.2 prefill:** EXL3 cooperative-input TensorOps require 26.3. Check runtime OS availability separately from M5 identity; retain existing portable QMV for older systems, including dense/grouped/routed dispatch.
- **Packed Qwen3.6/3.8 DFlash on macOS <26.4:** native int4 tensors are unavailable. Readiness/Tune no longer advertises that mode; loaders reject before file/GPU allocation. Raw Flash affine-Q4/ring remains separate. [Apple API timeline](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111432/).
- **Malformed Qwen config:** reject overflowing attention/GDN widths, invalid numerical constants, routing and layer geometry before resident weight loading; retain checked guards in direct constructors.
- **Direct DFlash→MTP (#45 A2):** retire both draft owners before validating/reusing/loading MTP, through the existing preparer used by all three callers.
- **Endless engine JSON line:** limit each complete/fragmented/unterminated frame to 8,000,000 bytes; report one bounded error, stop/join and recover. Large batches of valid small frames remain accepted.
- **Agent CI regression:** verify the real three-argument helper launch, external permission envelope, denied permissions through refresh and isolation across tasks.

The native OS query uses a bounded `kern.osproductversion` sysctl parser, avoiding a compiler-rt availability-helper dependency in Rust's link. macOS CI explicitly matches the shipped 26.2 deployment target. The initial link failure and correction are retained in the evidence.

## Exact-head verification snapshot

| Check | Outcome |
| --- | --- |
| Full Desktop/protocol/Python E2E | **Passed** — [run](https://github.com/0xZKnw/mlxl3/actions/runs/41038401994), including Agent contract and bridge frame/cleanup/recovery regressions |
| Native Linux and macOS | **Both passed** — [run](https://github.com/0xZKnw/mlxl3/actions/runs/41038402005), including shipped MLX/FFI build and four explicit no-GPU error-path tests |
| EXL3 conversion and packing proof | **Both passed** — [run](https://github.com/0xZKnw/mlxl3/actions/runs/41038402114) |
| Independent Apple MLX/FFI/loader job | **Passed** — [job](https://github.com/0xZKnw/mlxl3/actions/runs/41038402332/job/124004839417), actual native link and 1,190 parser ASan+UBSan checks |
| Independent guard proofs | **Incomplete/cancelled at the 15-minute job limit** — [job](https://github.com/0xZKnw/mlxl3/actions/runs/41038402332/job/124004839006). Metal API flag property passed 2 assertions / 4 covers; GDN full-width proof has no verdict; attention proof was not reached |
| Global Kani | **Failed after runner shutdown**, not a logged counterexample — [job](https://github.com/0xZKnw/mlxl3/actions/runs/41038402005/job/124005223598). 47 successful harness results across its two steps; next unchanged historical cache-allocation harness has no verdict |
| Kani Flash contract suite | **Still in progress at handoff** — [job](https://github.com/0xZKnw/mlxl3/actions/runs/41038402005/job/124005224167); not counted as passed |

**CI is not globally green.** No proof domain was reduced to hide an incomplete result. CPU proofs do not validate Metal numerics.

Local checks: **248 Rust passed / 6 ignored**, strict Clippy/format/build passed; **1,842 Python portable passed / 67 skipped / 2 deselected** plus **35 passed / 8 skipped** in two separate Modal modules. The 335-test targeted selection overlaps the portable run. Two Ling MLX modules remain unexecuted locally; initial dependency errors are archived. Guards include 8,192 independent boundary evaluations and detected temporary OS/overflow mutations. Actual Apple frontend checking used a temporary manifest only; the subsequent real native CI build passed.

[Report/support matrix/hardware protocol](https://github.com/0xZKnw/mlxl3/blob/16c765aade25ad6ff85f974aa6da16e3d93ae4df/docs/apple-silicon-stability-20261030.md) · [Evidence and source hashes](https://github.com/0xZKnw/mlxl3/blob/16c765aade25ad6ff85f974aa6da16e3d93ae4df/docs/measurements/apple-silicon-stability-20261030/verification.json).

## Limits and overlap

M1/M2/M3/M4/M5 physical matrix, low-RAM behavior, successful mode-switch numerical journeys and the new physical failed-head/logit regression remain unexecuted in this cloud pass. Existing packed-Q4 sanitizer caveats remain. No throughput, physical-memory saving or universal Mac compatibility claim. SSD review established no new lifetime/partial-read defect, so no speculative SSD change was made.

Production Desktop overlap is limited to `MLXL3Bridge.swift`; fixture/test overlap: `bridge-dispatch-check.swift`, `fake-desktop-engine.py`, `studio-modes-check.swift`. Compare with Justin's unpublished local work. No merge, release, deployment or installed-app replacement.

Infrastructure history: force-cancel of obsolete run 41035881383 was refused with `Forbidden` and was not retried. That concurrency group later released; the independent compatibility workflow left the old run intact. The environment briefly disconnected, then reconnected; local and remote final SHAs were reverified with no repeated push.
